units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:6:4">Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>יהב חד דינר לק׳ ונסב מיניה בשער זלילה וכ׳</he> (not <he>בשעה</he>) advanced one denar to a huckster and received all he bought of him at the lowest prices of the entire year.

Lev. R. s. 12 (ref. to Prov. XXIII, 29 sq.) זה שנכנס לבי ק׳ וכ׳ he who is the first to enter the tavern and the last to leave it; Yalk. Prov. 960 קְפֵלָא; a. fr.—Esp. keeper of a cook-shop, professional cook.
<cite ref="Chullin 97a:3">Ḥull. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>ליטעמיה ק׳ ארמאה</he> let a gentile cook taste it.
Ib. אמור רבנן בק׳ there are cases when the rabbis make the decision dependent on the taste of a gentile cook; a. fr.—Pl. (h.) קְפֵילָאוֹת, (ch.) קְפֵילַיָּא.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 11:30">Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 30</cite> <he>הנחתומים והק׳</he> the bakers and the tavern-keepers.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:5:4">Y. Shebu. VII, 38ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="K01380"><he>כַּתַּף</he></cite>.
